about.title: About OBAI
about.standfirst: Oceania Business Association Incorporated is a Melbourne-based, not-for-profit membership association.
about.introTitle: Based in Melbourne, connecting China, Australia and Oceania
about.introBody1: Oceania Business Association (OBAI) was founded in Melbourne as a not-for-profit membership association, with offices and service networks across Oceania, promoting trade cooperation, industry exchange and investment across China, Australia and the Asia-Pacific.
about.introBody2: Recognised and supported by government and business communities in both Australia and China, the association supports members' cross-border growth through its government and business network, industry chapters and the ABS one-stop market-entry services.
about.missionText: Anchored in government and business networks and organised through industry chapters, we provide one-stop cross-border support that helps members grow steadily in the Oceania market.
about.pillarsStandfirst: How the vision is delivered — the association's four core lines of work.
about.structureText: The association is governed by a council and executive team, supported by a professional secretariat, with industry chapters that can expand as new sectors develop.
about.partnershipsText: The association maintains partnerships with CCPIT branches and government bodies across multiple Chinese provinces and cities, with support from the Victorian State Government.
